messages:
danielle-partners: FYI — joint announcement timeline moved up. we need to lock SI co-sell handoff rules + account map by EOD tomorrow. can we run a quick triage here?
omar-sales: ack. i'll surface any active opportunities that might be affected. running a delta against our quarter book now.
lina-solutions: recommend temporary rule: SI may only claim accounts with existing proof-of-interest (POI tag) or active POC. avoids blind claiming.
vijay-product: agree. also add a 'no-customer-naming' clause until comms signoff. last time we leaked a beta customer and it caused churn. :grimacing:
talia-comm: i'll handle external messaging. internal playbook needs clear owner list for announcements and quote approvals.
raj-hw: logistics note — if SI includes HW as bundle, our stock reservation window is 2 weeks. need firm counts when claims are accepted.
odds-bot: reminder: weekly-partner-sync in 2h.
ops-bot: created doc: /shared/si-co-sell/roes.md (please populate).
omar-sales: how should we encode claims? prefer CSV with minimal fields so teams can ingest.
danielle-partners: proposed CSV schema:
```
acct_id,acct_name,current_owner,region,stage,origin_source,si_claimed,claim_timestamp,claim_basis
```
lina-solutions: can we add `poi_level` (1-3) to indicate strength of interest? helps prioritization.
danielle-partners: added poi_level to schema. new line:
```
acct_id,acct_name,current_owner,region,stage,origin_source,si_claimed,claim_timestamp,claim_basis,poi_level
```
omar-sales: conflict resolution? if AE and SI both claim, who wins?
danielle-partners: conflict ladder suggestion: (1) AE with active forecast override; (2) SI with signed SOW or NDA + POI≥2; (3) marketplace-origin leads go to marketplace team. escalate to @talia-comm for any public-facing conflicts.
vijay-product: add guardrail — SI claims require a 1-pager integration summary and a named SE for demo within 48h.
lina-solutions: 48h response SLA sounds good. if SI misses SLA, ownership reverts to AE and we log as 'SI_no_response'.
raj-hw: will publish SKU list + monthly allocation to /shared/hw-partner/pkgs.csv by EOD. include fields: sku,qty_allocated,lead_time.
talia-comm: additionally, no joint case studies or logos without explicit customer consent and comms signoff. please add to roes.md.
odds-bot: uploaded template: /shared/si-co-sell/claims_template.csv

claims_template.csv sample:
```
acct_123,Acme Corp,omar-sales,NA,discovery,partner_ref,false,,,,2
```

omar-sales: i'll run the sweep tonight and populate claims_template. anyone volunteering to triage collisions tomorrow AM?
lina-solutions: i'll be on the triage and take first pass.
danielle-partners: great — action list: omar = sweep + upload, raj = SKU CSV, lina = collision triage, talia = comms guardrails + approve public copy. i'll consolidate final ROE doc and ping legal if needed.
talia-comm: adding legal loop now. tagging in the doc for approval. :white_check_mark:
lina-solutions: one more ask — can we tag claims with `expected_phases` so we know if SI intends to run POC vs pilot vs direct sale? helps resourcing.
danielle-partners: added expected_phases to schema (values: poc,pilot,production). updated template path.
ops-bot: calendar created: "SI co-sell collisions triage" Tomorrow 9:30am PT — attendees danielle-partners, omar-sales, lina-solutions, raj-hw, talia-comm.
omar-sales: thanks all. i'll post the CSV when ready and flag conflicts in thread. :rocket:
